summary: Highlands REIT filed an 8-K announcing final results of its previously announced self-tender offer to buy up to 125,000,000 shares at $0.20 per share in cash. The offer expired September 29, 2026, and was oversubscribed: 135,380,970.82434 shares were tendered, so Highlands exercised its right to accept an additional 2% (10,380,970.82434 shares), purchasing all tendered shares for roughly $27.1 million, about 18.7% of shares outstanding at the September 1, 2026 commencement. Georgeson LLC served as information agent. Watch for pro-ration risk, payment timing, and any follow-on liquidity or NAV signals.
